papers.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
papers.desc: We introduce BDH-CQ, a reasoning model that combines in-context learning with recurrent latent reasoning.

papers.title: Agent Memory Distillation: Empowering Small LLM Agents with Hierarchical Teacher Memory
papers.desc: Memory systems have shown promise for improving agent performance, but their potential remains largely unexplored for small language models, which struggle to generate sufficient successful trajectories on their own.

papers.title: What to Edit Next: Visually Aligned Image-Editing Follow-Up Suggestions in Conversational Systems
papers.desc: Conversational assistants increasingly recommend follow-up edits to help users continue a task.

papers.title: OasisKV: Scaling In-Decode KV Cache Beyond HBM with Lookahead Sparse Prefetching
papers.desc: Large language model (LLM) inference serving is increasingly constrained by memory rather than compute.

papers.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
papers.desc: Leading large language model providers now conceal their models' step-by-step reasoning, or chain-of-thought, to protect intellectual property and limit information leakage.

papers.title: Scaling Inherently Interpretable Language Models
papers.desc: Interpretability is often treated as a tax on capability: language models are trained as opaque systems, then explained after the fact, with methods whose reliability is difficult to establish.

papers.title: RynnValue: Scaling Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance
papers.desc: General-purpose reward models are increasingly the bottleneck for scaling robot learning, yet the recipe for learning value-related capabilities from large-scale heterogeneous corpora remains underexplored.

papers.title: A^2E : An End-to-End Agent Auditing Engine
papers.desc: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), harnesses have become essential infrastructure for deploying agents across a wide range of domains.

papers.title: Factorized Hypothesis Search for Evidence-to-Taxonomy Retrieval
papers.desc: Large-taxonomy retrieval often assumes that the input already expresses the target concept.

papers.title: MMOOC: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Out-of-Context Evaluation in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.desc: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on a wide range of vision-language tasks, but often fail under imperfect or shifted contexts.

papers.title: The Loss Does Not See the Basis, but Adam Does
papers.desc: Gradient descent on a factored model W = UV^top is implicitly biased toward low-rank solutions, while Adam, starting from the same small initialization, is not.

papers.title: WeClawArena: An Auditable Sandbox and Benchmark for Cross-User Agents Collaboration and Security in Human-Centered Agent Networks
papers.desc: Recent advances in persistent personal-agent frameworks are making human-centered agent networks realistic deployment targets: each user can be served by an AI agent that acts on the user's behalf, maintains state, and communicates with other agents through social and task relations.

papers.title: Ego-OSCAR: Egocentric Open source Stereo CAptuRe System
papers.desc: We present Ego-OSCAR, an open-hardware, low-cost, head-mounted stereo-inertial capture device for egocentric data collection in the wild.

papers.title: Vision-Language Grounding as Bidirectional Concept Correspondence
papers.desc: Vision-language grounding connects language to visual content, yet most existing formulations reduce grounding to a unidirectional localization problem: given a prespecified text phrase or category name, identify the corresponding image region.

papers.title: CEAA: A Cognitive Embodied Agents Architecture for Interactive Computing Systems
papers.desc: The development of embodied Intelligent Virtual Agents (IVAs) that have cognitive capabilities in real-time interactive virtual environments remains a challenge, even with today's advancements in technology.
